summary: Harden the itf testing framework: Suite.MountAll mirrors the production route table, TestEnvironment.CommitTx/FreshTx formalize committed-seed scopes with rollback isolation, rollback-scope transactions gain a fail-fast concurrency guard (repo.GuardedTx / repo.ErrTxInUse), and i18n assertions (RequireMessage, MessageResolves) catch dot-path and partial-translation traps.
